author: /root/structural
statement: For every simple SRG(99,14,1,2) and its complete integer binary99x231 actual-triangle incidence matrix N, no nonzero x in L=ker(N^T mod3) has a lift X with N^T X=0 mod9. The lift-independent pairing gamma(x,u)=X^T N U/3 mod3 for x in L and u in K=ker(N mod3) has zero left radical and right radical exactly K_int, the reductions of exact integer relations ker_Z N. Thus gamma perfectly pairs L with K/K_int, dim K_int=132, and gamma(j,u)=sum(u). If L=span(j), balanced ternary right words are exactly integer-liftable words; a nonconstant L instead forces a balanced non-integer-liftable right word. No extra left dependency, minority-sign bound, target exclusion or same-support integer circuit lift is asserted.

scope.description: Every hypothetical complete finite simple99/degree14/adjacentCN1/nonadjacentCN2 graph and its full231-column actual-triangle incidence, exact integer lifting and ternary divided cross-pairing only. No fixed-support occurrence, circuit-sign restriction, mod3-only surrogate, graph symmetry or target conclusion.

assumptions: A is symmetric binary zero-diagonal with row sums14 and A^2=12I-A+2J exactly over the integers.
N includes every actual triangle exactly once, each column has three ones, each row seven ones, and NN^T=A+7I.
Integer-liftable right words may use additional columns and arbitrary integer coefficients; the lift is only required to preserve every original residue modulo3.
origin: Root requested a new unrestricted ternary attack; Structural derived NP=210I/no-left-mod9-lift and the pairing before Root independently sent the same pairing outline. Root-origin challenge is disclosed; agreement is not verification.
new_scope: Exact modulo-nine nonlifting and integer-right-relation classification. The rank77 floor, Gram Smith valuations and existence of an unbalanced right word are overlap and not new conclusions.
failed_or_limited_approaches: The complete rainbow-degree moment identities already occur in the earlier nonconstant-color note.
The balanced word supplied by an extra left dependency is not covered by the existing unbalanced minority-sign circuit bounds.
The integer lift may enlarge support and alter coefficients, so no same-support circuit lift follows.
No reason that a target must have a nonconstant left dependency has been obtained.
hand_boundaries: Two-block J4-I4 balanced nonliftable right word
diag(1,3) versus diag(1,9) same-mod3 corrupt boundary
Nine-point rook exact integer left dependency excludes parameter transfer
Modulo-nine dependencies reducing to zero remain allowed
